title: Pocketwire Rewards Points Ledger Standard: Points Clawed Back on a Refunded Purchase
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards clawback for a merchant refund is the points the refunded purchase earned, counting its earning entry and any boost entry for it, multiplied by the refunded amount divided by the purchase amount, rounded up to whole points, and it is taken from the points balance as it stands. On tiers whose clawback may not take the balance below zero, the clawback is then cut to the points balance on the handling date, never below zero, and the rest is written off; on other tiers it is taken in full.

## Inputs

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Refunded amount | the latest merchant refund posted on the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card ledger |
| Refunded purchase | the card purchase that refund carries |
| Purchase amount | that purchase's amount on the card ledger |
| Points the purchase earned | the points of the earning entry pointing to that purchase, together with the points of any boost entry pointing to it, on the points ledger |
| Points balance | the membership's points balance on the handling date |
| Balance setting | the tier's setting on whether a clawback may take the balance below zero |

Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.

## Worked example (hypothetical purchase)

A purchase of 84.00 USD earned 126 points on its earning entry and 300 points on its boost entry, 426 points in all. The merchant refunds 21.00 USD.

- 426 points multiplied by 21.00 divided by 84.00 is 106.5, rounded up to 107 points.
- On a tier whose clawback may take the balance below zero, 107 points are taken in full; with a balance of 50 points, the balance becomes minus 57 points.
- On a tier whose clawback may not take the balance below zero, with a balance of 60 points, the clawback is cut to 60 points and 47 points are written off.
- On that same tier with a balance of 0 points, the clawback taken is 0 points and all 107 are written off.

## Rounding

The clawback is rounded up: a result of 106.5 becomes 107, and a result of 40.01 becomes 41. A whole result, such as 106, stays as it is.
